content.short: RPC Benchmarking Tool compares Ethereum service providers based on consistency and accuracy.
content.description: RPC Benchmarking Tool is a utility designed to improve the developer experience when building smart contracts. It enables developers to run head-to-head tests across multiple RPC providers, allowing direct performance comparisons under realistic workloads. By surfacing standardized benchmarks, it helps teams gauge reliability and responsiveness and make informed choices about which providers to incorporate into their dApp projects. This approach supports clearer provider selection and smoother integration across the supported chains.
